summary: Phase 2 catalogue construction validated end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest passing (products list, filters by sub_category/pet_type/featured, detail 200/404, leads regression). Frontend: /catalogue no longer shows coming-soon, 3 sub-category cards render, each sub page (/catalogue/food, /catalogue/hygiene, /catalogue/vitamins) renders exactly 6 ProductCards under the expected data-testid grid, Popular badge appears on featured products, brand block + will-include block render below grid. Clicking a product card opens signup-modal; modal closes cleanly; navigation continues to work (nav-home → /). WhatsApp FAB visible on all 4 catalogue routes. Header signup CTA still opens modal on /catalogue/food. Zero console errors on any catalogue route.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_products.py reuses some image URLs across food/vitamins (e.g. IMG['kibble_cat'] is used for both 'hills-science-plan-adult-cat' and 'beaphar-salmon-oil' via IMG['omega'] — both point to /7210754/). Functional but slightly confusing; consider distinct images per item for visual variety.

seed_products.py: idempotency relies on count_documents({}) being 0. If a partial insert ever fails midway, the collection will be non-empty but missing items and seeding will not re-run. Acceptable for now; future-proof by upserting on slug.
Backend GET /api/products has no pagination (to_list(500)). With 18 docs today it is fine but should be paginated before opening the catalogue to user-generated/curated data.
Backend featured query accepts featured=true via FastAPI query parsing; works, but for clarity consider documenting that featured=false also works (it does — verified).

ProductCard.jsx uses a <button> wrapping the entire card and opens the signup modal on click. Once a real PDP exists, swap to <Link to={`/product/${slug}`}> to preserve a11y and SEO; today the click target is fine and accessible.
ProductGrid.jsx error copy mentions 'Refresh, or message us on WhatsApp' — there is no retry button. Adding a retry button calling refetch() from useQuery would improve UX on transient failures.
Pet-type filter logic: when pet_type='dog' is requested, response also includes pet_type='both' products (correct by design — 'both' means dog OR cat). Confirmed in tests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required Phase 2 + Phase 1 regression flows passed)

seed_data_creation: TEST_Phase2 lead inserted via /api/leads during regression test. Products seeded by FastAPI startup hook (idempotent, 18 docs).
